evaluation.period: 2014-01-01 to 2014-12-31 UTC (test partition, 12 complete billing months)
evaluation.savings_basis: before tax; net benefit = no-battery bill - strategy bill - degradation cost; for ML and robust dispatch also minus the assumed annual operating cost (config/battery.yaml#operating_cost); the fixed schedule needs no forecast or review

agents.recommendation_accuracy: agent_assisted > numbers_only on the 30 scenario set

withhold: economics failure on B-19 (neither ML nor robust dispatch passes)
revise: any stress test breaches a stress limit

proceed.scope: every real tariff on which at least one of ML or robust dispatch passes economics, naming the passing strategies. A PGE economics failure narrows the scope and does not trigger revise. Synthetic tariffs are reported, not scoped.

observed_peak_kw.source: max kw_mean in the train split of edip.curated.load_observations
observed_peak_kw.note: training data only, so no test information sets the battery size

fixed_schedule.charge: full power from 00:00 local in each tariff's off-peak hours until soc_max
fixed_schedule.discharge: Full power in the local hours with the highest training-period average load inside the tariff's demand window, until the battery reaches soc_min. Hours are ranked separately for each tariff and season from the train split only; the battery discharges in clock order through the top-ranked hours.
